F.name: Cross-Receiver Identity Contrastive Learning
F.chinese_name: 跨接收机身份对比学习
F.architecture: SIG_TIME_X3; time/frequency/PA/reference residual fusion; centered Sinc and unit-aware updates; native joint cosine head
F.supervision: Six real labeled forwards: .5 RDord128 + .25 RDord64 + .25 CEpair_As64(KL0) + .25 RDraw128; same IQ within pair; total CE dose1.25; LS0.01

contrast.denominator: positive set plus different TX; exclude same TX/same RX
contrast.single_source: No eligible cross-RX positives; finite zero loss and report zero anchor coverage
contrast.scope: Only original ordinary128 shallow/middle maps, two ordinary forwards; cumulative epoch warm/ramp

F.SSL: Original ownEMA0.999 + rx/day quantile confidence + batch-neighbor + strong-agreement + PL0.16 + entropy0.01. User-fixed native exception, not ordinaryPL.
F.satellite_training: Native final T1 As64 residual practical from raw source L, no As KL. Matched supervision/plainPL additionally use default concat satCE0.68; report recipe difference.
F.default_head: Jointly trained original cosine head; never fit or replace after freezing
F.deployment: Single frozen student; no EMA, RDrop second pass, contrast loss or U gate execution
F.continuation: Strict own previous student AND own EMA; reset AdamW/cos20/cos10/cos20 and temporal state. New data contracts train every segment from matching scratch ancestry.

G.name: DURA v1.0
G.training: TX-label-free, F-free source L/U simulated IQ pairs; all ancestors must match the actual source contract

existing_evidence.uncertainty: F-seed variation conditional on one frozen G; not three independently trained full systems
existing_evidence.scope: HISTORICAL old33L17U noAs F + DURA only; MUST NOT label as final T1+DURA

contract_policy: New RX/day/TX/role splits require exact-contract F and full G ancestry; no silent old-weight fallback
final_T1_evidence: Three existing exact-contract final T1 checkpoints verified; new paired T1+DURA seven-view predictions/scores pending current immutable run
